summary: A premium Business Bay clinic appears to lose bookings because every Book Consultation button leads to a contact page and key details conflict.

findings.problem: Every Book Consultation button appears to lead to the same contact page, with no visible booking form or scheduler.
findings.cost: Patients ready to book face extra steps and drop off.
findings.fix: An on page booking form or scheduler.

findings.problem: No opening hours appear, and the address appears as Prime Tower in the header and Prime 28 Ltd Building in the footer.
findings.cost: Patients cannot tell when to call or exactly where to go.
findings.fix: Visible hours and one consistent address.

findings.problem: The brand appears as Oval Dental Clinic, Oval Dental, Oval Clinic and OVAL DENTAL CLINIC L.L.C., and typos such as a expert team appear.
findings.cost: Mixed names and typos undercut a luxury positioning.
findings.fix: One brand name and proofread copy.

findings.problem: A 4.82 rating appears without a review source, and reviews name doctors who do not appear on the team list.
findings.cost: Unlinked proof does not persuade high value patients.
findings.fix: Linked reviews and a complete team page.
